tools.description: Search captured emails in an inbox by recipient, sender, subject or arrival time. Returns full emails (bodies, links, codes included) and the full match count as total; offset pages past the limit.

from.description: Case-insensitive substring of the header From address

offset.description: Matches to skip, newest first; total is counted before paging

since_ms.description: Arrival time lower bound in ms since the epoch; negative values are legal

to.description: Case-insensitive substring of any recipient: the To and Cc headers and the SMTP envelope recipients (RCPT TO, so a Bcc'd address matches) — not a header-presence assertion

tools.name: swarmail_search_emails

tools.description: Lazy versioned report from stored bytes. Only the synthetic demo rule ships; empty findings do not imply deliverability. Returns report JSON in a text block (2025-03-26).
tools.name: swarmail_get_deliverability_report

tools.description: Fetch one captured email in full by id.
tools.name: swarmail_get_email

tools.description: Fetch the most recent email(s) in an inbox.
tools.name: swarmail_get_latest_email

tools.description: Delete one captured email by id (start the next assertion clean).
tools.name: swarmail_delete_email

tools.description: Delete all emails in one inbox — the 'clear' of the clear/act/assert loop.
tools.name: swarmail_clear_inbox

tools.description: Delete every email in every inbox.
tools.name: swarmail_clear_all

tools.description: Block until count emails matching the filter arrive (push-based, no polling). Returns the matched emails. Waits at most timeout_ms (60000 at most) and races the server's shutdown, answering an error once it begins stopping. A count of 0 still means at least one (decision 0010). Waits inside one batch run concurrently; their effects have no order.

count.description: Matched emails to wait for; 0 still means at least one

from.description: Case-insensitive substring of the header From address

no_findings_at_or_above.description: Qualify messages with no findings at or above this inclusive threshold; analysis failures are operational errors

since_ms.description: Arrival time lower bound in ms since the epoch; negative values are legal

to.description: Case-insensitive substring of any recipient: the To and Cc headers and the SMTP envelope recipients (RCPT TO, so a Bcc'd address matches) — not a header-presence assertion

tools.name: swarmail_wait_for_email

tools.description: Extract all http(s) URLs from a captured email's text/HTML bodies.
tools.name: swarmail_extract_links

tools.description: Extract likely OTP/verification codes from a captured email.
tools.name: swarmail_extract_codes

tools.description: Inject a synthetic email into an inbox without sending SMTP — fixtures for agent tests. HTML is preserved verbatim and supersedes text; envelope fields (to, from, subject) containing CR, LF or NUL are refused before anything is stored.
tools.name: swarmail_seed_email

tools.description: Enable deliberate SMTP failure: event = connect|mail_from|rcpt|data, probability 0-100, optional SMTP error line (a single line starting with a 4xx or 5xx code, at most 510 octets) and delay_ms (at most 300000).

error.description: A single-line SMTP reply starting with a 4xx or 5xx code, at most 510 octets

tools.name: swarmail_set_chaos
